name: Diamond no Kuni no Alice ~Wonderful Wonder World~
original_name: ダイヤの国のアリス ～Wonderful Wonder World～
source:
Alice Liddell finds herself falling down as usual with Peter holding her in his arms. She tries to ask him what's going on, but he magically vanishes without saying a word and dumps her into the Country of Diamonds. Its major areas are the Castle of Diamonds, The Hatter Mansion, The Train Station and the Graveyard & Art Museum (which are right next to each other.) Alice is now in a new country but unlike her previous move from Heart to Clover, nobody here remembers who she is—except for Nightmare.

Suddenly characters like Nightmare and Ace are shotas, Dee & Dum are only in adult form and Vivaldi, Gowland and Pierce are missing in action. Additionally the castle of Diamonds is run by the queen of Diamonds, Crysta Snowpigeon and the new prime minister is now a black rabbit named Sidney Black. Over at the art museum & cemetery area is another mafia with a leader by the name of Jericho Bermuda who is a dodo bird. Alice has to figure out what the hell is going on and at the same time try to convince everyone to like her again. Unfortunately, unlike the country of Hearts, everyone's feelings towards her are as cold as a frozen diamond.

[Edited from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/12/31/otome-game-review-diamond-no-kuni-no-alice-wonderful-wonder-world/]Hinano's Game Babbles[/url]]
translation:
愛麗絲．利德爾照常墜落，佩塔抱著她。她試圖問他發生了什麼，但他一言不發地消失，把她扔進了鑽石之國。主要區域有鑽石城堡、帽子屋宅邸、火車站和墓地與美術館（彼此緊鄰）。愛麗絲現在來到了一個新國家，但與之前從心之國轉移到幸運草國不同，這裡沒有人記得她是誰——除了夢魘。突然間，夢魘和艾斯變成了正太，迪和達姆只有成人形態，維瓦爾第、高蘭和皮爾斯不見了蹤影。此外，鑽石城堡由鑽石女王克里斯塔．雪鴿管理，新任首相是一隻叫悉尼．布萊克的黑兔子。在美術館和墓地區域還有另一個黑手黨，首領是一隻叫傑里科．百慕大的渡渡鳥。愛麗絲必須弄清楚到底發生了什麼，同時試圖讓所有人重新喜歡她。不幸的是，與心之國不同，所有人對她的感情都像冰凍的鑽石一樣冰冷。
